WITH race_country_wins AS (
  SELECT c.country, r.raceId, AVG(ds.wins) AS avg_race_wins
  FROM races r
  JOIN circuits c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId
  JOIN driverStandings ds ON ds.raceId = r.raceId
  GROUP BY c.country, r.raceId
), country_averages AS (
  SELECT country, AVG(avg_race_wins) AS average_wins
  FROM race_country_wins
  GROUP BY country
), overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(average_wins) AS overall_average
  FROM country_averages
), above_overall AS (
  SELECT ca.country, ca.average_wins, o.overall_average
  FROM country_averages ca CROSS JOIN overall o
  WHERE ca.average_wins > o.overall_average
), group_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(average_wins) AS above_group_average
  FROM above_overall
)
SELECT ao.country,
       ao.average_wins,
       ao.average_wins - ao.overall_average AS above_overall_average,
       ao.average_wins - ga.above_group_average AS above_group_average
FROM above_overall ao
CROSS JOIN group_average ga
WHERE ao.average_wins > ga.above_group_average
ORDER BY ao.country;
